title: The Griffon Legend maintained C port
license_expectations: The maintained port states source code is GPL-2.0 and all non-source assets are CC-BY-NC-ND-3.0
README identifies Daniel Syn9 Kennedy as programming/graphics author and David Turner as music/sound-effects author
The asset-license statement first appeared in port maintainer Dmitry Smagin's 2013-10-10 commit 8c1207b3dd65e9e14f318a3ceb4deef7057fcc32
This audit does not establish that Daniel Kennedy and David Turner authorized Dmitry Smagin to license their original assets; production stays HOLD until that authority chain is established
Even if authority is established, CC-BY-NC-ND-3.0 requires a noncommercial and unmodified deployment boundary that Abandonware does not currently assume
reason: This source audit preserves materially stronger rights evidence discovered after the original Griffon Legend HOLD. It is non-publishing evidence gathering only: the maintained C port makes an explicit GPL/CC license claim, but the authority for relicensing the original authors' assets and the NC/ND deployment constraints remain unresolved.
